title: Sapiom, which helps businesses build, ship, and scale AI agents and lower token costs, raised a $35M Series A led by Dragonfly, taking its total funding to $50M (Reed Albergotti/Semafor)
summary: Reed Albergotti / Semafor: Sapiom, which helps businesses build, ship, and scale AI agents and lower token costs, raised a $35M Series A led by Dragonfly, taking its total funding to $50M — THE SCOOP — Quintessential San Francisco AI startup Polsia employs nobody and operates swarms of AI agents to help run other businesses.
